title: The Regular

pre.en: Why did the woman always get a flat white?
pre.zh: 那位女士为什么总是喝澳白？
options: Her friends at work drank it too.
It was the cheapest drink in the café.
She ordered one by mistake and was too polite to say so.

intro: 一篇新概念式的小故事，讲故事的是车站旁一家小咖啡馆的老板。开头两句用一般现在时交代现在的情况，后面用一般过去时讲那两年里的一位常客和那一周发生的事。读的时候留意过去式：规则动词加 -ed，不规则动词各有各的样子；最后几句话会让你重新看待前面的两年。

sentences.en: I run a little café near the station, and most of my customers are regulars.
sentences.zh: 我在车站附近开了家小咖啡馆，来的大多是熟客。

sentences.en: I don't always know their names, but I always know their coffee.
sentences.zh: 他们叫什么我不一定知道，可他们喝什么咖啡，我门儿清。

sentences.en: There was this woman in a grey coat.
sentences.zh: 有这么一位女士，总穿一件灰大衣。

sentences.en: For two years, she came in at 7:45 every morning, always in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 整整两年，她每天早上七点四十五分进门，每次都急匆匆的。

sentences.en: The first time, she ordered a flat white.
sentences.zh: 她第一次来，点了一杯澳白。

sentences.en: After a week, I started making one as soon as I saw her at the door, and she never had to queue.
sentences.zh: 过了一个星期，我一看见她出现在门口就开始做，她从来不用排队。

sentences.en: She just smiled, paid, picked it up and ran for her train.
sentences.zh: 她就笑一笑，付了钱，拿起咖啡就跑去赶火车。

sentences.en: Then one week, she didn't come in.
sentences.zh: 后来有一个星期，她没来。

sentences.en: By Wednesday, I was really worried.
sentences.zh: 到了星期三，我是真着急了。

sentences.en: It didn't make sense — she never missed a day.
sentences.zh: 这太奇怪了——她可是一天都没落下过。

sentences.en: Was she ill?
sentences.zh: 她是病了吗？

sentences.en: Was there a better café somewhere?
sentences.zh: 还是找到别家更好的咖啡馆了？

sentences.en: On Friday at 7:45, I made a flat white again.
sentences.zh: 星期五早上七点四十五，我又做了一杯澳白。

sentences.en: I didn't do it on purpose — it was just habit.
sentences.zh: 我不是故意的——纯粹是习惯了。

sentences.en: That afternoon, I found out from another regular that she was on holiday in Spain.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，我听另一位熟客说，她去西班牙度假了。

sentences.en: The next Monday, she was back, and very tanned.
sentences.zh: 下个星期一，她回来了，晒得黑黑的。

sentences.en: Her flat white was waiting on the counter, but this time she didn't pick it up.
sentences.zh: 她的澳白已经摆在柜台上了，可这回她没去拿。

sentences.en: She took a deep breath.
sentences.zh: 她深吸了一口气。

sentences.en: "OK, to be honest, I don't really like flat whites," she said.
sentences.zh: 「好吧，说实话，我其实不太喜欢喝澳白，」她说。

sentences.en: "That first day, I was in such a hurry that I ordered one by mistake.
sentences.zh: 「第一次来那天，我太赶了，点错了。

sentences.en: And after that, you always had it ready, so I just got used to it.
sentences.zh: 后来你每次都给我提前做好，我也就这么喝惯了。

sentences.en: You were so nice, I couldn't tell you!"
sentences.zh: 你人这么好，我怎么好意思说！」

sentences.en: Then she smiled.
sentences.zh: 说完她笑了。

sentences.en: "So... could I have a tea, for a change?"
sentences.zh: 「那个……今天能换杯茶吗？」

cards.note: 做形容词是「规律的、经常的」：a regular customer；当名词直接说 a regular，是咖啡馆、酒吧的常用说法。
英式拼写是 grey，美式是 gray。in a grey coat 用 in 表示「穿着」：the man in the black jacket。
doing something quickly because you do not have much time
cards.tip: 中间的 a 不能省：in a hurry，不说 in hurry。「不着急，慢慢来」说 There's no hurry。
cards.example: I left the house in a hurry and forgot my laptop charger.

cards.zh: 澳白（一种奶咖，也叫馥芮白）
cards.note: 浓缩咖啡加一层薄薄的热牛奶，比拿铁奶少、咖啡味浓；点单时说 a flat white, please。
英式常用词，也能当名词：a long queue；美式多说 line / wait in line。
to lift something, or to collect something that is waiting for you
cards.tip: 代词要放中间：pick it up，不说 pick up it。开车去「接人」也用它：pick sb up at the airport。
cards.example: Can you pick up my parcel from reception on your way in?

cards.note: to have a clear meaning that is easy to understand
miss a day 是「缺一天」；没赶上车是 miss the train。还有「想念」的意思：I miss you。
because you want to, not by accident
it was just habit = 纯属习惯；也常说 out of habit（出于习惯）。
to get information about something, often by asking someone or by chance
cards.tip: find 是「找到（东西）」：find my keys；find out 是「得知消息、弄清真相」：find out why / find out that …。过去式 found out。
cards.example: I only found out about the meeting from a colleague.

cards.note: 名词是 tan：get a tan 晒出健康的肤色；晒伤是 sunburnt。
商店、咖啡馆的收银台或取餐台；at the counter 在柜台前。

cards.zh: 深吸一口气（给自己壮胆、让自己镇定）
cards.note: to breathe in a lot of air, especially to calm yourself before something difficult
cards.tip: breath 是名词，读 /breθ/；breathe 是动词，读 /briːð/。take a deep breath = breathe deeply。
cards.example: I took a deep breath and clicked "Send".

cards.note: used before you say what you really think, especially something the listener may not like
cards.tip: 放在句首，后面加逗号；常用来引出对方可能不爱听的真话，比 Actually 更坦白。
cards.example: To be honest, I don't think we can finish this by Friday.

cards.note: without intending to, because of an error
cards.tip: 反义说法是第 1 课的 on purpose（故意）。by mistake 一般放在动作后面：delete it by mistake。
cards.example: I sent the email to the whole team by mistake.

cards.note: to become familiar with something new so that it no longer feels strange
in order to do something different from what you usually do
cards.tip: 常放句末，说「跟平时不一样一回」。别和 change（找的零钱）弄混：Here's your change. 是「找您的零钱」。
cards.example: Let's have the meeting outside for a change.
